question: {If } x² + (1)/(x²) = 123, { then a possible value of } (x - (1)/(x)) { is:}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then (x − 1/x) = √(k − 2).

Here, k = 123.

∴ (x − 1/x) = √(123 − 2) = √121 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x² + 1/x² = 123

Formula used: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ Let a = x and b = 1/x

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = x² + (1/x)² − 2 × x × (1/x)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2

⇒ Substitute the given value of x² + 1/x²:

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 123 − 2

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 121

⇒ x − 1/x = ±√121

⇒ x − 1/x = 11 (taking the positive value from options)

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identity

If x² + 1/x² = k, then (x + 1/x) = √(k + 2).

Cubic Relation

If (x − 1/x) = a, then the value of x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

Fourth Power Relation

If x + 1/x = a, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² − 2)² − 2.
